translated_title: Mexico Has Paid 1.6 Trillion Pesos on the Fobaproa Bank Bailout, yet the Debt Keeps Growing: “A Scam,” Says the Finance Secretary
original_title: México ya pagó 1.6 billones de Fobaproa. La deuda sigue creciendo. “Una estafa”: SHCP
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
meta_description: A 1990s bailout that turned private bank losses into public debt — serviced with interest alone, it now claims 48 billion pesos of the 2027 budget.
